summary: KE Holdings Inc. via Form 6-K filed HKEx-mandated Next Day Disclosure Returns for June 17-18, 2026, detailing ongoing share repurchases on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code 02423) and in the US. Multiple buybacks executed between May 22 and June 16, 2026, at prices ranging from ~HKD 42.44 to HKD 45.01 per share and ~USD 5.30 to USD 5.76 per ADS. The filing reports cumulative reductions in issued shares but notes certain repurchased shares not yet cancelled. This structured capital return program signals management's intent to return capital to shareholders while reducing overhang. Monitor future repurchase cadence and potential cancellation for accretion impact.
